title: OFG Bancorp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: This is a standard SEC Form 8-K filing for OFG Bancorp, a Puerto Rico-based bank holding company, reporting routine shareholder voting results from its April 22, 2026 annual meeting. The filing covers election of nine directors, an advisory vote on executive compensation (approved), and ratification of KPMG LLP as independent auditor (approved). This corporate governance document contains no information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: OFG Bancorp held its annual shareholder meeting on April 22, 2026
Nine director nominees were elected to one-year terms with votes ranging from 36.0 to 36.5 million shares for each nominee
Advisory vote on executive compensation was approved with 36,003,479 votes for and 599,690 against
Selection of KPMG LLP as independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2026 was ratified with 38,432,272 votes for
No market-moving disclosures or material events were reported in this 8-K filing
